entries.title: Psalms 123:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 123:2
segments: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] unto the hand of their masters, as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress, so our eyes [are directed] to Jehovah our God, until he be gracious unto us.

entries.title: Psalms 123:3
segments: Be gracious unto us, O Jehovah, be gracious unto us; for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

entries.title: Psalms 123:4
segments: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
